low_effort_experiment.interpretation: Two of three low-effort runs passed all checks with fewer prompt tokens than the two earlier high-effort runs. The third exceeded the budget and its completion guard could not confirm verification even though the independent fixture grader later passed. The final response claimed verification; available evidence does not establish whether the agent actually ran that command or why its evidence was missing. Small, nonpaired samples with changed worktree state do not justify changing the default or claiming a causal improvement.
